articles.title: Digital Gold May Come Under RBI-SEBI Oversight; Physical Gold Backing Proposed
articles.description: Reports suggest the government is considering tighter rules for digital gold, including mandatory physical bullion backing for every unit and possible joint oversight by RBI and SEBI. The digital gold segment in India is estimated to manage around $3 billion in assets, with an average ticket size of ₹100. The discussions come amid concerns around investor protection, regulatory gaps and unregulated players. If implemented, the proposed framework could bring greater regulatory oversight and standardisation to a rapidly growing segment.

articles.title: Sensex down over 10,800 points in 2026. Should mutual fund investors stay invested, increase SIPs or wait for clarity?
articles.description: The BSE Sensex has experienced a notable drop, raising concerns among investors. Financial analysts recommend avoiding attempts to time the market and encourage maintaining systematic investment plans (SIPs). For those with a long-term outlook, gradually increasing equity allocations is advisable. Additionally, rebalancing portfolios during market corrections is an effective strategy for achieving target asset allocations. Flexi-cap and multi-cap funds may provide a level of stability for fresh investments.

This practice psychologically separates individuals from their possessions. Living with fewer things creates greater physical and psychological freedom. Danshari teaches that letting go fosters intentional living and less attachment.
